sortilin.description: Sortilin / SORT1 Vps10p domain (human). CNS-biased LTR; best single-domain EndoTag reported (21 nM).

numbering.warning: 0-based indices below are relative to clean_file, which is the file a design run must upload. They are NOT auth numbers and NOT UniProt numbers.

notes: 4PO7 resolves a SECOND neurotensin site (chains N and P); both are merged into the avoid set by --extra-ligand-structs.
6X3L carries compound UMJ at the progranulin-interaction site, a third native-ligand surface worth avoiding.

asgpr.description: ASGPR / ASGR1 carbohydrate-recognition domain (human). Liver-restricted LTR; the classic tri-GalNAc receptor.

numbering.warning: 0-based indices below are relative to clean_file, which is the file a design run must upload. They are NOT auth numbers and NOT UniProt numbers.

notes: ZPF is the compact galactosamine mimic -> marks the glycan site that a protein binder must avoid, or it will compete with GalNAc ligands.
CA is the structural Ca2+ of the C-type lectin fold; its site is part of the glycan-binding machinery.
5JQ1 contains two CRD copies (chains A and B); ASGPR is a trimer in vivo, so inter-CRD spacing sets the 2C/3C multivalent linker span.

igf2r_bovine.description: IGF2R / CI-M6PR full ectodomain WITH IGF2 bound (Bos taurus). Ubiquitous LTR. The only structure holding D6 and D11 in one frame.

numbering.warning: 0-based indices below are relative to clean_file, which is the file a design run must upload. They are NOT auth numbers and NOT UniProt numbers.

native_ligand_clamp.note: span between the two native-ligand footprints: the proven bivalent geometry

orthogonal_clamp_option.note: junction residues that are exposed AND outside the native-ligand footprint: where a non-competitive bivalent binder would have to bind. Whether enough surface survives is threshold-dependent, so the sweep below is the result -- not a single verdict.

native_ligand_clamp_raw_contacts.note: span between the two native-ligand footprints: the proven bivalent geometry

D6__D11.caveat: independently best-scoring patches can sit on opposite outer faces and overstate the span; prefer the clamp_analysis spans

notes: SPECIES TRAP: this is bovine IGF2R (P08169). The paper designed D6 on this structure but D11 on human 1GP0 (P11717). A D6 binder optimised on bovine coordinates is not guaranteed to transfer to human.
IGF2 bridges D11 and D6, so IGF2 itself is the natural bivalent cross-domain ligand -- which is why single-domain engagement fails to drive uptake.

igf2r_d11_human.description: IGF2R domain 11, human (P11717), 1.4 A. Correct-species template for the D11 arm.
